facts.fact: The Global Data Barometer report lists freedom of information legislation among the transparency reforms Nigeria has adopted over the past two decades.

NGA.note: The report names a beneficial ownership register under the Companies and Allied Matters Act but does not say it holds the owners of all companies, or state online registration or a shared number.
Nothing on online public participation in policy is stated.
Only availability scores are given; no portal, licence or publishing bodies are named.
No consultation on a named digital law or policy is described.
